stress_test_design.summary: Augment regulatory and internal stress tests with FM-generated regime-aware overlays.

im_vm_forecasting.summary: Apply correct+reweight to IM/VM forecasting via joint probabilistic paths with covariate conditioning.

frtb_ima_es.summary: Build a challenger ES alongside FRTB IMA stressed-ES using FM-augmented tail paths.

market_data_gap_filling.summary: Fill stale or sparse market series with FM conditioning on observable cross-asset features.

scenario_limits.summary: Replace fixed predefined scenarios with continuous regime-weighted FM scenario manifolds for limits.

long_context_windows.summary: Use multi-decade conditioning history for regime characterization beyond rolling windows.

temporal_hierarchies.summary: Joint intraday/daily/macro forecasting in one model: intraday PFE, vol-surface forecasting, event windows.
